comparison.objective: Use two lines to keep a rising boat against a lock wall, then cleat both lines taut; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Dynamic bimanual tension regulation, deformable-line handling, and cleating versus rigid precision-tool alignment, impact control, and small-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Boat remains against the wall throughout its rise, both lines end taut and fast, and both are released versus four safe fractures and all tangs contained. Numeric wall-gap and tension thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Dynamic rope tending and fastening are meaningfully different from rigid-body notch fracture; this record also implies deformable physics absent from the candidate.
